pendentes.titulo: Avell Storm 480: o que entrega um notebook com i9 e RTX 4080
pendentes.alt: Notebook gamer preto aberto, de frente, com a tela colorida acesa e o teclado iluminado em vermelho sobre uma mesa escura
pendentes.pedido: Front three-quarter view of a large black gaming laptop, lid fully open, facing the camera, on a dark desk. The screen glows with vivid abstract blurred shapes in red, orange and purple, no text. The backlit keyboard emits a soft red glow, slightly out of focus. Thin red light strip along the front edge. Dark gaming room background with bokeh lights, cinematic premium product photography, sharp focus on the screen bezel and hinge.
